patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: I've taken four COVID tests and every one is negative, so what IS it? I feel like I've been hit by a bus. But it's just a cold, isn't it?
clinical.presentationShort: 34yo F, healthy — 3 days coryza, cough and myalgia. No dyspnoea, chest clear.
clinical.presentationLong: 34-year-old healthy female with three days of coryza, cough and muscle aches; no breathlessness and a clear chest.

diagnosis.primary: Viral upper respiratory infection (RSV) in a healthy adult
diagnosis.esi2roomsNotes: ESI 5: no ED treatment-area resources are expected; brief evaluation, counseling, and discharge are appropriate.
diagnosis.disposition: Discharge → symptomatic care, return if breathless
diagnosis.why: A negative COVID test rules out one virus out of hundreds. Healthy adult, clear chest, normal saturations — this is a cold with a name.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: an asian 34-year-old woman wrapped in a cardigan with a scarf, seated on a blue padded clinic chair
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting hunched into her cardigan, a wad of tissues in one hand
aiImageGeneration.expression: thoroughly fed up but perfectly well
aiImageGeneration.lookSeverity: miserable with a cold and otherwise entirely well
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. Subject: an asian 34-year-old woman wrapped in a cardigan with a scarf, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting hunched into her cardigan, a wad of tissues in one hand. Expression: thoroughly fed up but perfectly well. Clearly visible: a red sore-looking nose; tissues clutched in one hand. Overall: miserable with a cold and otherwise entirely well. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no border.
